found.quote: Your drawing has a small 16px square icon sitting inside the 34px Save reading control; in the build the square is far larger than that — it fills the button's full height and bulges past its top and bottom edges, nothing like a 16px mark inside a 34px control. The label "Save reading" is beside it

It is the blue primary action, but your drawing has "Publish board" on one line across a 160px button; in the build the button is only 74px wide so the label wraps onto TWO lines ("Publish" over "board"), and the box is 41px tall instead of the 34px control height because of the wrap. Impact medium

The chip reads "2 readings stale" correctly, but your drawing paints it red (#c0392b) as a warning; in the build it is GREEN (rgb(30,142,62)) — which reads as a healthy, all-good state, exactly what the PRD says it must not do. Impact high because the PRD says this warning must not read as healthy,

The eyebrow (HARBOUR) and the Tide Board title are both there and correct, but your drawing puts Help in the top-right of the head; in the build it sits at the top-LEFT, tucked right under the title (measured x=45, hard against the left edge, while the head runs out to x=846). Impact medium because

Your drawing has an Export CSV button sitting beside Publish; in the build it isn't there at all — the row goes Save reading, Publish board, then straight to the green "2 readings stale" chip, with no Export button anywhere (exportBtn reads present:false).
